name: Acerola's Mischief
rules: You can use this card only if your opponent has 2 or fewer Prize cards remaining.  Choose 1 of your Pokémon in play. During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to that Pokémon by your opponent's Pokémon ex.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

name: Air Balloon
rules: The Retreat Cost of the Pokémon this card is attached to is ColorlessColorless less.
You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.

name: Buddy-Buddy Poffin
rules: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon with 70 HP or less and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

name: Fighting Gong
rules: Search your deck for a Basic Fighting Energy card or a Basic Fighting Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

name: Lillie's Determination
rules: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 6 cards. If you have exactly 6 Prize cards remaining, draw 8 cards instead.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

name: Lt. Surge's Bargain
rules: Ask your opponent if each player may take a Prize card. If yes, each player takes a Prize card. If no, you draw 4 cards.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

name: Mega Signal
rules: Search your deck for a Mega Evolution Pokémon ex, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

name: Mystery Garden
rules: Once during each player's turn, that player may discard an Energy card from their hand in order to draw cards until they have as many cards in their hand as they have Psychic Pokémon in play.
You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.

name: Night Stretcher
rules: Put a Pokémon or a Basic Energy card from your discard pile into your hand.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

name: Premium Power Pro
rules: During this turn, attacks used by your Fighting Pokémon do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

name: Rare Candy
rules: Choose 1 of your Basic Pokémon in play. If you have a Stage 2 card in your hand that evolves from that Pokémon, put that card onto the Basic Pokémon to evolve it, skipping the Stage 1. You can't use this card during your first turn or on a Basic Pokémon that was put into play this turn.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

name: Wally's Compassion
rules: Heal all damage from 1 of your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex. If you healed any damage in this way, put all Energy attached to that Pokémon into your hand.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

name: Mega Venusaur ex
rules: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Solar Transfer
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn, you may use this Ability. Move a Basic Grass Energy from 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon.

attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Mega Symphonia

name: Mega Lucario ex
rules: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Mega Brave

name: Mega Absol ex
rules: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Claw of Darkness
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand, and you discard a card you find there.

name: Mega Latias ex
rules: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Strafe
attacks.text: You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Illusory Impulse
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

rules: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

rules: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.text: For each of your Benched Pokémon, search your deck for a Basic Psychic Energy card and attach it to that Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Mega Symphonia
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage for each Psychic Energy attached to all of your Pokémon.

name: Mega Lucario ex
rules: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Aura Jab
attacks.text: Attach up to 3 Basic Fighting Energy cards from your discard pile to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Mega Brave
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Mega Brave.

name: Oddish
flavorText: Its scientific name is Oddium wanderus. It is said to cover distances as far as 1,000 feet when night falls, walking on its two roots.

name: Gloom

attacks.name: Disperse Drool
attacks.text: This attack also does 20 damage to each Benched Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's). (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

flavorText: The fluid that oozes from its mouth isn't drool. It is a nectar that is used to attract prey.

name: Vileplume

attacks.name: Pollen Bomb
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep and Poisoned.

attacks.name: Lively Flower
attacks.text: If this Pokémon was healed during this turn, this attack does 120 more damage.

flavorText: The bud bursts into bloom with a bang. It then starts scattering allergenic, poisonous pollen.

name: Mega Heracross ex
rules: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Juggernaut Horn
attacks.text: If this Pokémon was damaged by an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does that much more damage.

attacks.name: Mountain Ramming
attacks.text: Discard the top 2 cards of your opponent's deck.

name: Lotad
flavorText: The leaf on its head is naturally dirt repellent and will stay clean even after transporting Pokémon that are covered in mud.

name: Lombre

attacks.name: Mega Drain
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

flavorText: It prefers waterfronts with plentiful food. It became nocturnal so it wouldn't have to compete for food with bird Pokémon.

name: Ludicolo

abilities.name: Excited Heal
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if you have any Grass Mega Evolution Pokémon ex in play, you may use this Ability. Heal 60 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

flavorText: There are structures throughout its whole body that produce energy when hit by sound waves with a cheerful rhythm.

name: Genesect

attacks.name: Bug's Cannon
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon for each Grass Energy attached to this Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

flavorText: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

name: Nymble

attacks.name: Flail Around
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

flavorText: It has its third set of legs folded up. When it's in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.

name: Lokix

attacks.name: Jumping Shot
attacks.text: Shuffle this Pokémon and all attached cards into your deck.

flavorText: When it decides to fight all out, it stands on its previously folded legs to enter Showdown Mode. It neutralizes its enemies in short order.

name: Charmander

abilities.name: Agile
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has no Energy attached, it has no Retreat Cost.

flavorText: The flame on its tail shows the strength of its life-force. If Charmander is weak, the flame also burns weakly.

name: Charmeleon
flavorText: When it swings its burning tail, the temperature around it rises higher and higher, tormenting its opponents.

name: Mega Charizard X ex
rules: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Inferno X
attacks.text: Discard any amount of Fire Energy from among your Pokémon, and this attack does 90 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

name: Moltres

attacks.name: Fighting Wings
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon ex, this attack does 90 more damage.

flavorText: There are stories of this Pokémon using its radiant, flame-cloaked wings to light up paths for those lost in the mountains.

name: Darumaka

attacks.name: Blaze Ball
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Fire Energy attached to this Pokémon.

flavorText: This popular symbol of good fortune will never fall over in its sleep, no matter how it's pushed or pulled.

name: Darmanitan

attacks.name: Blaze Ball
attacks.text: This attack does 40 more damage for each Fire Energy attached to this Pokémon.

flavorText: This Pokémon's power level rises along with the temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Reshiram

attacks.name: Burning Flare
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 60 damage to itself.

flavorText: According to myth, if people ignore truth and let themselves become consumed by greed, Reshiram will arrive to burn their kingdoms down.

name: Oricorio ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Excited Turbo
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn, if you have any Fire Mega Evolution Pokémon ex in play, you may use this Ability. Attach a Basic Fire Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Benched Fire Pokémon.

name: Charcadet

attacks.name: Gather Strength
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

flavorText: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

name: Ceruledge

attacks.name: Infernal Slash
attacks.text: Discard 4 Basic Fire Energy cards from your hand. If you can't discard 4 cards in this way, this attack does nothing.

flavorText: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.

name: Seel

attacks.name: Bubble Drain
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

flavorText: The protrusion on its head is very hard. It is used for bashing through thick ice.

name: Dewgong

abilities.name: Thick Fat
abilities.text: This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Fire or Water Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Slam
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 70 damage for each heads.

flavorText: It sleeps under shallow ocean waters during the day, then looks for food at night when it's colder.

name: Swinub
flavorText: It searches for food by digging into the ground with its snout. Even frozen ground doesn't give it any trouble.

name: Piloswine

attacks.name: Rising Lunge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

flavorText: Covered by a shaggy coat, it is resistant to the cold. Its tusks of ice thicken when it snows.

name: Mamoswine

attacks.name: Wreck
attacks.text: If a Stadium is in play, this attack does 120 more damage. Then, discard that Stadium.

attacks.name: Blizzard Edge
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

flavorText: A frozen Mamoswine was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. This Pokémon has been around a long, long, long time.

name: Suicune

attacks.name: Crystal Fall
attacks.text: If you have at least 4 Water Energy in play, this attack does 90 more damage.

flavorText: Said to be the embodiment of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

name: Piplup

attacks.name: Call for Support
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

flavorText: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.

name: Prinplup

attacks.name: Targeted Dive
attacks.text: This attack does 70 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

flavorText: It lives a solitary life. Its wings deliver wicked blows that can snap even the thickest of trees in half with a single hit.

name: Rotom ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Multi Adapter
abilities.text: Each of your Pokémon that has "Rotom" in its name may have up to 2 Pokémon Tool cards attached. If this Ability goes away, discard Pokémon Tools from those Pokémon until only 1 remains on each.

attacks.name: Thunderbolt
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

name: Yamper

attacks.name: Play Rough
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

flavorText: This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.

name: Boltund

attacks.name: Electric Run
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 70 more damage.

flavorText: It sends electricity through its legs to boost their strength. Running at top speed, it easily breaks 50 mph.

name: Pawmi

attacks.name: Growl
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, attacks used by the Defending Pokémon do 30 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

flavorText: It has underdeveloped electric sacs on its cheeks. These sacs can produce electricity only if Pawmi rubs them furiously with the pads on its forepaws.

name: Pawmo
flavorText: When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the first to leap into battle, defeating enemies with a fighting technique that utilizes electric shocks.

name: Pawmot

attacks.name: Voltaic Fist
attacks.text: You may have this Pokémon also do 60 damage to itself and make your opponent's Active Pokémon Paralyzed.

flavorText: This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies with lightning-fast movements.

name: Misdreavus
flavorText: This Pokémon startles people in the middle of the night. It gathers fear as its energy.

name: Mismagius ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Swirling Prose
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, whenever your opponent's Active Pokémon moves to the Bench during their turn, their new Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Hexa-Magic
attacks.text: You may draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.

name: Snubbull
flavorText: In truth, it is a cowardly Pokémon. It growls eagerly in order to hide its fear from its opponent.

name: Granbull

attacks.name: Finishing Blow
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 90 more damage.

flavorText: It is actually timid and easily spooked. If attacked, it desperately flails its limbs about in an attempt to repel its opponent.

name: Cresselia

attacks.name: Swelling Light
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Psychic Energy cards and attach them to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

flavorText: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

name: Meloetta

attacks.name: Soothing Melody
attacks.text: Heal 120 damage from 1 of your Benched Psychic Pokémon.

flavorText: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

name: Mega Diancie ex
rules: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Diamond Coat
abilities.text: This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Garland Ray
attacks.text: Discard up to 2 Energy cards from this Pokémon, and this attack does 120 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

name: Mimikyu

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

flavorText: This Pokémon lives in dark places untouched by sunlight. When it appears before humans, it hides itself under a cloth that resembles a Pikachu.

name: Milcery

attacks.name: Draining Kiss
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

flavorText: The more sweet aromas it absorbs, the more its body swells. Milcery will deflate when its energy level drops.

name: Alcremie

attacks.name: Sweet Circle
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each of your Pokémon in play.

flavorText: Desserts that Alcremie have decorated with their cream have a rich, sweet flavor and bring happiness to all who eat them.

name: Zacian

attacks.name: Limit Break
attacks.text: If your opponent has 3 or fewer Prize cards remaining, this attack does 90 more damage.

flavorText: Able to cut down anything with a single strike, it became known as the Fairy King's Sword, and it inspired awe in friend and foe alike.

name: Bramblin

attacks.name: Sneaky Placement
attacks.text: Place 1 damage counter on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

flavorText: A soul unable to move on to the afterlife was blown around by the wind until it got tangled up with dried grass and became a Pokémon.

name: Brambleghast

abilities.name: Prison Panic
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may use this Ability. Make your opponent's Active Pokémon Confused.

flavorText: It will open the branches of its head to envelop its prey. Once it absorbs all the life energy it needs, it expels the prey and discards it.

name: Paldean Tauros

attacks.name: Raging Charge
attacks.text: This attack does 40 damage for each of your Pokémon that has "Tauros" in its name that has any damage counters on it.

attacks.name: Double-Edge
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

flavorText: This Pokémon has a muscular body and excels at close-quarters combat. It uses its short horns to strike the opponent's weak spots.

name: Gligar

attacks.name: Poison Jab
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

flavorText: It builds its nest on a steep cliff. When it is done gliding, it hops along the ground back to its nest.

name: Gliscor

attacks.name: Poison Ring
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. During your opponent's next turn, that Pokémon can't retreat.

flavorText: If it succeeds in catching even a faint breeze properly, it can circle the globe without flapping once.

name: Trapinch

attacks.name: Double Headbutt
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

flavorText: This Pokémon lives in arid deserts. It patiently awaits prey inside its funnel- shaped nest.

name: Vibrava
flavorText: Rather than using its underdeveloped wings for flight, it rubs them together, emitting ultrasonic waves to attack its enemies.

name: Flygon

abilities.name: Sandy Flapping
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may use this Ability. You may also use this Ability if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon. Discard the top 2 cards of your opponent's deck.

flavorText: Known as the Desert Spirit, this Pokémon hides in the sandstorms it causes by beating its wings.

name: Gastly
flavorText: It wraps its opponent in its gas-like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.

name: Haunter
flavorText: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

name: Mega Gengar ex
rules: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Shadowy Concealment
abilities.text: If 1 of your Darkness Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon ex, that player takes 1 fewer Prize card. The effect of Shadowy Concealment doesn't stack.

attacks.name: Void Gale
attacks.text: Move an Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

name: Murkrow

attacks.name: Ambush
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

flavorText: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

name: Honchkrow

attacks.name: Sniping Feathers
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon, and this attack does 120 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

flavorText: It is merciless by nature. It is said that it never forgives the mistakes of its Murkrow followers.

name: Sableye

attacks.name: Cocky Claw
attacks.text: If you have any Stage 2 Darkness Pokémon on your Bench, this attack does 70 more damage.

flavorText: It dwells in the darkness of caves. It uses its sharp claws to dig up gems to nourish itself.

name: Carvanha

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

flavorText: These Pokémon have sharp fangs and powerful jaws. Sailors avoid Carvanha dens at all costs.

name: Mega Sharpedo ex
rules: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Greedy Fang
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Hungry Jaws
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any damage counters on it, this attack does 150 more damage.

name: Seviper

abilities.name: Excited Power
abilities.text: If you have any Darkness Mega Evolution Pokémon ex in play, attacks used by this Pokémon do 120 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

flavorText: It sharpens its swordlike tail on hard rocks. It hides in tall grass and strikes unwary prey with venomous fangs.

name: Absol

attacks.name: Allure
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

flavorText: Because of this Pokémon's ability to detect danger, people mistook Absol as a bringer of doom.

name: Sandile
flavorText: It submerges itself in sand and moves as if swimming. This wise behavior keeps its enemies from finding it and maintains its temperature.

name: Krokorok
flavorText: Protected by thin membranes, their eyes can see even in the dead of night. They live in groups of a few individuals.

name: Krookodile

attacks.name: Vengeful Fang
attacks.text: If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does 160 more damage.

flavorText: After clamping down with its powerful jaws, it twists its body around to rip its prey in half.

name: Toxel

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

flavorText: It has no problem drinking dirty water. An organ inside Toxel's body filters such water into a poisonous liquid that is harmless to Toxel.

name: Toxtricity

abilities.name: Sinister Surge
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Search your deck for a Basic Darkness Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Benched Darkness Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. If you attached Energy to a Pokémon in this way, place 2 damage counters on that Pokémon.

flavorText: As it scatters toxic sweat and emits electricity, a melody that sounds like it came from a guitar reverberates through the surrounding area.

name: Eternatus

attacks.name: Shatter
attacks.text: Discard a Stadium in play.

attacks.name: Power Rush
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, during your next turn, this Pokémon can't use attacks.

flavorText: The core on its chest absorbs energy emanating from the lands of the Galar region. This energy is what allows Eternatus to stay active.

name: Empoleon ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Emperor's Stance
abilities.text: Prevent all effects of attacks used by your opponent's Pokémon done to this Pokémon. (Damage is not an effect.)

attacks.name: Iron Feathers
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 60 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

name: Bronzor

attacks.name: Iron Defense
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks.

flavorText: Ancient people believed that the pattern on Bronzor's back contained a mysterious power.

name: Bronzong

attacks.name: Triple Draw
attacks.text: Draw 3 cards.

attacks.name: Tool Drop
attacks.text: This attack does 40 damage for each Pokémon Tool attached to all Pokémon.

flavorText: In ages past, this Pokémon was revered as a bringer of rain. It was found buried in the ground.

name: Togedemaru

attacks.name: Find a Friend
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

flavorText: When it's in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges electricity indiscriminately.

name: Duraludon

attacks.name: Hyper Beam
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavorText: Duraludon's body is comprised of a special metal that's lightweight and scratch resistant. It's also smooth, as though it was given a mirror finish.

name: Archaludon

attacks.name: Coated Attack
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Basic Pokémon.

flavorText: It gathers static electricity from its surroundings. The beams it launches when down on all fours are tremendously powerful.

name: Jigglypuff

attacks.name: Ball Roll
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

flavorText: When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

name: Wigglytuff

attacks.name: Round
attacks.text: This attack does 40 damage for each of your Pokémon in play that has the Round attack.

flavorText: It has a very fine fur. Take care not to make it angry, or it may inflate steadily and hit with a body slam.

name: Aipom

attacks.name: Astonish
attacks.text: Choose a random card from your opponent's hand, and your opponent reveals that card and shuffles it into their deck.

flavorText: It lives atop tall trees. When leaping from branch to branch, it deftly uses its tail for balance.

name: Ambipom

attacks.name: Dual Tail
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon, and this attack does 60 damage to each of 2 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

flavorText: They live on large trees. They are said to communicate by connecting their tails to those of others.

name: Smeargle

attacks.name: Energizing Sketch
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. Attach an amount of Basic Energy up to the number of heads from your discard pile to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like.

flavorText: Once a Smeargle reaches adulthood, it will have other members of its species leave paw prints on its back.

name: Zigzagoon

attacks.name: Surprise Attack

name: Marill

attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Spiky Rolling
attacks.text: If this Pokémon used Spiky Rolling during your last turn, this attack does 80 more damage.

name: Dratini
flavorText: This Pokémon is full of life energy. It continually sheds its skin and grows steadily larger.

name: Dragonair

abilities.name: Evolutionary Guidance
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon has any Energy attached, you may use this Ability. Search your deck for an Evolution Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

flavorText: Its crystalline orbs appear to give this Pokémon the power to freely control the weather.

name: Mega Dragonite ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Sky Transport
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Ryuno Glide
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

name: Rayquaza

attacks.name: Breakthrough Assault
attacks.text: If this Pokémon moved from your Bench to the Active Spot this turn, this attack does 90 more damage.

flavorText: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.

name: N's Reshiram

attacks.name: Powerful Rage
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

flavorText: According to myth, if people ignore truth and let themselves become consumed by greed, Reshiram will arrive to burn their kingdoms down.

name: N's Zekrom

attacks.name: Shred
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Rampaging Thunder
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use attacks.

flavorText: When the interior part of its tail spins like a motor, Zekrom can generate many bolts of lightning to blast its surroundings.

name: Noibat

attacks.name: Knickknack Carrying
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Pokémon Tool card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

flavorText: Even a robust wrestler will become dizzy and unable to stand when exposed to its 200,000-hertz ultrasonic waves.

name: Noivern

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Enhanced Blade
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attached, this attack does 70 more damage.

flavorText: They fly around on moonless nights and attack careless prey. Nothing can beat them in a battle in the dark.

name: Dreepy
flavorText: It has a habit of biting at Clauncher even though it doesn’t feed on them. This is said to be vestigial behavior from when Dreepy was alive.

name: Drakloak

abilities.name: Recon Directive
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may look at the top 2 cards of your deck and put 1 of them into your hand. Put the other card on the bottom of your deck.

flavorText: This Pokémon stores up energy in its lungs, then shoots it out. It takes care of Dreepy and battles alongside them until they’re all grown up.

name: Dragapult ex
rules: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent’s).
Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Phantom Dive
attacks.text: Put 6 damage counters on your opponent's Benched Pokémon in any way you like.

name: Team Rocket's Meowth

attacks.name: Paw-cket Pilfer
attacks.text: Choose a random card from your opponent's hand. Your opponent reveals that card and shuffles it into their deck.

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

flavorText: All it does is sleep during the daytime. At night, it patrols its territory with its eyes aglow.

name: Team Rocket's Kangaskhan ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Comet Punch
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Wicked Impact
attacks.text: If you played a Supporter card that has "Team Rocket" in its name from your hand during this turn, this attack does 100 more damage.

name: Larry's Dunsparce

attacks.name: Rising Lunge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

flavorText: If spotted, it escapes by burrowing with its tail. It can float just slightly using its wings.

name: Larry's Dudunsparce ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Work Rush
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each Energy attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 80 damage for each heads.

name: Skitty
flavorText: It can’t stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.

name: Delcatty

attacks.name: Energy Crush
attacks.text: This attack does 40 damage for each Energy attached to all of your opponent's Pokémon.

flavorText: It dislikes dirty places. It often searches for a comfortable place in which to groom itself.

name: Zangoose ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Spike Draw
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Wild Scissors
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

name: Larry's Starly

attacks.name: Minor Errand-Running
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

flavorText: Because they are weak individually, they form groups. However, they bicker if the group grows too big.

name: Larry's Staravia
flavorText: They maintain huge flocks, although fierce scuffles break out between various flocks.

name: Larry's Staraptor

attacks.name: Facade
attacks.text: If this Pokémon is Burned or Poisoned, this attack does 100 more damage.

attacks.name: Feathery Strike
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon, and this attack also does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

flavorText: It never stops attacking even if it is injured. It fusses over the shape of its comb.

name: Fan Rotom

abilities.name: Fan Call
abilities.text: Once during your first turn, you may search your deck for up to 3 Colorless Pokémon with 100 HP or less, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You can't use more than 1 Fan Call Ability during your turn.

attacks.name: Assault Landing
attacks.text: If there is no Stadium in play, this attack does nothing.

flavorText: There are several appliances that Rotom can inspirit, but the first one to be developed was the electric fan.

name: Mega Audino ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Kaleidowaltz
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. For each heads, search your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Ear Force
attacks.text: This attack does 80 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

name: Larry's Rufflet

attacks.name: Peck the Wound
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 80 more damage.

flavorText: With its sharp claws, this Pokémon pierces its prey, and then it pecks at them. Although it also consumes berries, it’s a carnivore at heart.

name: Larry's Braviary

attacks.name: Clutch
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

attacks.name: Brave Bird
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

flavorText: For the sake of its friends, this brave warrior of the sky will not stop battling, even if injured.

name: Larry's Komala

abilities.name: Lethargic Charge
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is on your Bench, you may use this Ability. Attach an Energy card from your hand to your Active Larry's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dozing Draw
attacks.text: This Pokémon is now Asleep. Draw 2 cards.

flavorText: A potent anesthetic can be made by diluting Komala’s drool. This anesthetic was used for surgeries in the past.

name: Drampa

attacks.name: Dragon Strike
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Dragon Strike.

flavorText: It has a compassionate personality, but if it is angered, it completely destroys its surroundings with its intense breath.

name: Hop's Cramorant

attacks.name: Fickle Spitting
attacks.text: If your opponent doesn't have exactly 3 or 4 Prize cards remaining, this attack does nothing.

flavorText: Cramorant instinctively swallow everything whole. They’re at their most formidable when they’re struggling to swallow overly large prey.

name: Terapagos

attacks.name: Prism Charge
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Energy cards of different types and attach them to your Tera Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.

flavorText: The shell is made of crystallized Terastal energy. When struck by a move, this shell absorbs the move’s energy and transfers it to Terapagos.

name: Terapagos ex
rules: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent’s).
Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Unified Beatdown
attacks.text: If you go second, you can't use this attack during your first turn. This attack does 30 damage for each of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Crown Opal
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Basic non-Colorless Pokémon.

name: Acerola's Mischief
rules: You can use this card only if your opponent has 2 or fewer Prize cards remaining.  Choose 1 of your Pokémon in play. During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to that Pokémon by your opponent's Pokémon ex.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

name: Air Balloon
rules: The Retreat Cost of the Pokémon this card is attached to is ColorlessColorless less.
You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.

name: Anthea & Concordia
rules: You can use this card only if you have N's Darmanitan, N's Zoroark ex, N's Vanilluxe, N's Klinklang, N's Reshiram, and N's Zekrom in play.  During this turn, if your opponent's Active Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack used by your N's Pokémon, take 3 more Prize cards.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

name: Boss's Orders
rules: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

name: Buddy-Buddy Poffin
rules: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon with 70 HP or less and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

name: Canari
rules: You can use this card only if you discard another card from your hand.  Search your deck for up to 4 Lightning Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

name: Counter Gain
rules: If you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent, attacks used by the Pokémon this card is attached to cost Colorless less.
You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.

name: Fighting Gong
rules: Search your deck for a Basic Fighting Energy card or a Basic Fighting Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

name: Forest of Vitality
rules: Each player's Grass Pokémon can evolve into Grass Pokémon during the turn they play those Pokémon, except during their first turn.
You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can’t be played.

name: Glass Trumpet
rules: You can use this card only if you have any Tera Pokémon in play.  Choose up to 2 of your Benched Colorless Pokémon and attach a Basic Energy card from your discard pile to each of them.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

name: Iris's Fighting Spirit
rules: You can use this card only if you discard another card from your hand.  Draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

name: Light Ball
rules: Attacks used by the Pikachu ex this card is attached to do 50 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon ex (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.

name: Lillie's Determination
rules: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 6 cards. If you have exactly 6 Prize cards remaining, draw 8 cards instead.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

name: Mega Signal
rules: Search your deck for a Mega Evolution Pokémon ex, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

name: Mystery Garden
rules: Once during each player's turn, that player may discard an Energy card from their hand in order to draw cards until they have as many cards in their hand as they have Psychic Pokémon in play.
You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can’t be played.

name: N's PP Up
rules: Attach a Basic Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched N's Pokémon.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

name: Night Stretcher
rules: Put a Pokémon or a Basic Energy card from your discard pile into your hand.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

name: Nighttime Mine
rules: Attacks used by each Tera Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) cost Colorless more.
You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can’t be played.

name: Poké Pad
rules: Search your deck for a Pokémon that doesn't have a Rule Box, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. (Pokémon ex, Pokémon V, etc. have Rule Boxes.)
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

name: Premium Power Pro
rules: During this turn, attacks used by your Fighting Pokémon do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

name: Surfer
rules: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

name: Team Rocket's Archer
rules: You can use this card only if any of your Team Rocket's Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn.  Each player shuffles their hand into their deck. Then, you draw 5 cards, and your opponent draws 3 cards.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

name: Team Rocket's Ariana
rules: Draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand. If all of your Pokémon in play are Team Rocket's Pokémon, draw cards until you have 8 cards in your hand instead.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

name: Team Rocket's Factory
rules: Once during each player's turn, if they played a Supporter card that has "Team Rocket" in its name from their hand this turn, they may draw 2 cards.
You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can’t be played.

name: Team Rocket's Giovanni
rules: Switch your Active Team Rocket's Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Team Rocket's Pokémon. If you do, switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

name: Team Rocket's Great Ball
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for an Evolution Team Rocket's Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If tails, search your deck for a Basic Team Rocket's Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

name: Team Rocket's Hypnotizer
rules: If the Team Rocket's Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Team Rocket's Pokémon is Knocked Out), the Attacking Pokémon is now Asleep.
You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.

name: Team Rocket's Petrel
rules: Search your deck for a Trainer card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

name: Team Rocket's Proton
rules: If you go first, you may use this card during your first turn.  Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Team Rocket's Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

name: Team Rocket's Transceiver
rules: Search your deck for a Supporter card that has "Team Rocket" in its name, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

name: Team Rocket's Watchtower
rules: Colorless Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) have no Abilities.
You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can’t be played.

name: Thick Scale
rules: The Dragon Pokémon this card is attached to takes 50 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Grass, Fire, Water, or Lightning Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance).
You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.

name: Tool Scrapper
rules: Choose up to 2 Pokémon Tools attached to Pokémon (yours or your opponent's) and discard them.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

name: Ultra Ball
rules: You can use this card only if you discard 2 other cards from your hand. Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

name: Urbain
rules: Draw 3 cards.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

name: Waitress
rules: Look at the top 6 cards of your deck and attach a Basic Energy card you find there to 1 of your Pokémon. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

name: Prism Energy
rules: As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides Colorless Energy.  If this card is attached to a Basic Pokémon, this card provides every type of Energy but provides only 1 Energy at a time.

name: Team Rocket's Energy
rules: This card can only be attached to a Team Rocket's Pokémon. If this card is attached to anything other than a Team Rocket's Pokémon, discard this card.  As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides 2 in any combination of Psychic Energy and Darkness Energy.

name: Erika's Tangela

abilities.name: Gathering of Blossoms
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Search your deck for an Erika's Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Bind
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

flavorText: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon’s true appearance remains a mystery.

name: Beautifly

attacks.name: Stun Spore
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Energy Straw
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand, and this attack does 80 damage for each Energy card you find there.

flavorText: Vibrantly patterned wings are its prominent feature. It sucks sweet flower nectar with its long mouth.

name: Dustox

abilities.name: Boisterous Wind
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Flip a coin. If heads, put an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon into their hand.

attacks.name: Twilight Poison
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep and Poisoned.

flavorText: A nocturnal Pokémon. Drawn by streetlights, they messily eat the leaves of trees lining boulevards.

name: Budew

attacks.name: Itchy Pollen
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, they can't play any Item cards from their hand.

flavorText: The pollen it releases contains poison. If this Pokémon is raised on clean water, the poison’s toxicity is increased.

name: Ethan's Magcargo

abilities.name: Melt Away
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has no Energy attached, it has no Retreat Cost.

attacks.name: Lava Burst
attacks.text: Discard up to 5 Fire Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 70 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

flavorText: This Pokémon lives near the craters of volcanoes. It stores fire energy in its shell of cooled and hardened magma.

name: Numel

abilities.name: Incandescent Body
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), the Attacking Pokémon is now Burned.

flavorText: The magma in its body reaches 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit. Its hump gets smaller when it uses Fire-type moves.

name: Salazzle

attacks.name: Sudden Scorching
attacks.text: Your opponent discards a card from their hand. If this Pokémon evolved from Salandit during this turn, your opponent discards 2 more cards.

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

flavorText: When two Salazzle meet, they will use their pheromone gas to fight over the males in each other’s group.

name: Scorbunny

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.

flavorText: Fire energy gathers in the pads of its feet, raising their temperature. Once hot, Scorbunny’s footpads can deal heavy damage to opponents.

name: Psyduck

abilities.name: Damp
abilities.text: Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) lose any Ability that requires the Pokémon using it to Knock Out itself.

flavorText: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.

name: Snorunt
flavorText: In some snowy lands, certain folklore says a house will prosper if a Snorunt lives there.

name: Weavile

attacks.name: Hail Claw
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon. Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

flavorText: They travel in groups of four or five, leaving signs for one another on trees and rocks. They bring down their prey with coordinated attacks.

name: Heliolisk

abilities.name: Frilled Generator
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if you played Canari from your hand this turn, you may use this Ability. Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Lightning Energy cards and attach them to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Powerful Bolt
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each Energy attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 70 damage for each heads.

flavorText: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.

name: Vikavolt

attacks.name: Volt Switch
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Lightning Pokémon.

flavorText: When carrying a Charjabug, Vikavolt can receive electricity from it and then rapidly fire powerful electromagnetic beams from its large jaws.

name: Iono's Wattrel

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

flavorText: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

name: Marill

attacks.name: Hide
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

flavorText: The oil-filled tail functions as a buoy, so it’s fine even in rivers with strong currents.

name: Misdreavus

attacks.name: Ascension
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

flavorText: It loves to bite and yank people’s hair from behind without warning, just to see their shocked reactions.

name: Banette

attacks.name: Cursed Words
attacks.text: Your opponent chooses 3 cards from their hand and shuffles those cards into their deck.

flavorText: This Pokémon developed from an abandoned doll that amassed a grudge. It is seen in dark alleys.

name: Togekiss

abilities.name: Wonder Kiss
abilities.text: When your opponent's Active Pokémon is Knocked Out, flip a coin. If heads, take 1 more Prize card. The effect of Wonder Kiss doesn't stack.

flavorText: These Pokémon are never seen anywhere near conflict or turmoil. In recent times, they’ve hardly been seen at all.

name: Slurpuff
flavorText: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.

name: Hop's Trevenant

attacks.name: Horrifying Revenge
attacks.text: If any of your Hop's Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does 100 more damage.

attacks.name: Corner
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

flavorText: Using its roots as a nervous system, it controls the trees in the forest. It’s kind to the Pokémon that reside in its body.

name: Team Rocket's Mimikyu

attacks.name: Gemstone Mimicry
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Tera Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack.

flavorText: This Pokémon lives in dark places untouched by sunlight. When it appears before humans, it hides itself under a cloth that resembles a Pikachu.

name: Team Rocket's Dugtrio

abilities.name: Holes
abilities.text: Whenever your opponent's Active Pokémon moves to the Bench during their turn, place 2 damage counters on that Pokémon.

flavorText: In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected direction.

name: Hitmontop

attacks.name: Spin and Draw
attacks.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 6 cards.

flavorText: It spins on its horn while dealing out elegant kicks. Its horn grows continuously through its lifetime.

attacks.name: Seventh Kick
attacks.text: If you don't have exactly 7 cards in your hand, this attack does nothing.

abilities.name: Double Type
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in play, it is Fighting and Psychic type.

attacks.name: Counter Jewel
attacks.text: If your opponent has 2 or fewer Prize cards remaining, this attack does 100 more damage.

name: Mightyena

attacks.name: Kick Away
attacks.text: Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

flavorText: It will always obey the commands of a skilled Trainer. Its behavior arises from its living in packs in ancient times.

name: Cynthia's Spiritomb

attacks.name: Raging Curse
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage for each damage counter on all of your Benched Cynthia's Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness.

flavorText: Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.

name: Galarian Obstagoon

attacks.name: Scarring Shout
attacks.text: This attack does 70 damage for each damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Punk Smash
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

flavorText: Its voice is staggering in volume. Obstagoon has a tendency to take on a threatening posture and shout—this move is known as Obstruct.

name: Mawile

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

flavorText: Attached to its head is a huge set of jaws formed by horns. It can chew through iron beams.

name: Dreepy
flavorText: It has a habit of biting at Clauncher even though it doesn’t feed on them. This is said to be vestigial behavior from when Dreepy was alive.

name: Drakloak

abilities.name: Recon Directive
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may look at the top 2 cards of your deck and put 1 of them into your hand. Put the other card on the bottom of your deck.

flavorText: This Pokémon stores up energy in its lungs, then shoots it out. It takes care of Dreepy and battles alongside them until they’re all grown up.

name: Larry's Staraptor

attacks.name: Facade
attacks.text: If this Pokémon is Burned or Poisoned, this attack does 100 more damage.

attacks.name: Feathery Strike
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon, and this attack also does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

flavorText: It never stops attacking even if it is injured. It fusses over the shape of its comb.

name: Fan Rotom

abilities.text: Once during your first turn, you may search your deck for up to 3 Colorless Pokémon with 100 HP or less, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You can't use more than 1 Fan Call Ability during your turn.

attacks.name: Absorb

flavorText: When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body. The cotton serves as a decoy to distract the attacker.

flavorText: The color and scent of their fur changes to match the mountain grass. When they sense hostility, they hide in the grass.

name: Sawsbuck

attacks.name: Push Down
attacks.text: Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

flavorText: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck's horns.

name: Shelmet

abilities.name: Stimulated Evolution
abilities.text: If you have Karrablast in play, this Pokémon can evolve during your first turn or the turn you play it.

flavorText: When attacked, it defends itself by closing the lid of its shell. It can spit a sticky, poisonous liquid.

name: Accelgor

attacks.name: Acid Spray
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavorText: When its body dries out, it weakens. So, to prevent dehydration, it wraps itself in many layers of thin membrane.

name: Virizion

attacks.name: Giga Drain
attacks.text: Heal from this Pokémon the same amount of damage you did to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Emerald Blade
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use attacks.

flavorText: This Pokémon fought humans in order to protect its friends. Legends about it continue to be passed down.

name: Tepig
flavorText: It can deftly dodge its foe's attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

name: Pignite
flavorText: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

name: Emboar

abilities.name: Inferno Fandango
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn, you may attach a Basic Fire Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon.

flavorText: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

name: Pansear

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

flavorText: When it is angered, the temperature of its head tuft reaches 600° F. It uses its tuft to roast berries.

name: Simisear
flavorText: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body.

name: Litwick

attacks.name: Brighten and Burn
attacks.text: Look at the top card of your deck. You may discard that card.

flavorText: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.

name: Lampent

attacks.name: Fire Blast
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

flavorText: This ominous Pokémon is feared. Through cities it wanders, searching for the spirits of the fallen.

name: Chandelure

attacks.name: Incendiary Pillar
attacks.text: If you have 10 or more Basic Fire Energy cards in your discard pile, this attack does 100 more damage.

attacks.name: Burn It All Up
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

flavorText: It absorbs a spirit, which it then burns. By waving the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a hypnotic trance.

name: Heatmor

attacks.name: Licking Catch
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 in any combination of Fire Pokémon and Basic Fire Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

flavorText: It breathes through a hole in its tail while it burns with an internal fire. Durant is its prey.

name: Reshiram ex

attacks.text: This attack does 50 more damage for each Prize card your opponent has taken. Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

name: Oshawott
flavorText: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

name: Dewott

attacks.name: Energized Shell

flavorText: Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.

name: Samurott

attacks.name: Energized Slash
attacks.text: This attack does 50 more damage for each Energy attached to this Pokémon.

flavorText: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.

name: Basculin

attacks.name: Bared Fangs
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has no damage counters on it before this attack does damage, this attack does nothing.

flavorText: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they'll start fighting instantly. These Pokémon are very hostile.

name: Ducklett

attacks.name: Firefighting

flavorText: These bird Pokémon are excellent divers. They swim around in the water eating their favorite food--peat moss.

name: Swanna

attacks.name: Air Slash
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

flavorText: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

name: Vanillite

attacks.name: Ice Edge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

flavorText: The temperature of their breath is -58° F. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them.

name: Vanillish

attacks.name: Ice Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

flavorText: Snowy mountains are this Pokémon's habitat. During an ancient ice age, they moved to southern areas.

name: Vanilluxe

attacks.name: Double Freeze
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 90 damage for each heads. If either of them is heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

flavorText: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and attack their foes with violent blizzards.

name: Keldeo ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Gale Thrust
attacks.text: If this Pokémon moved from your Bench to the Active Spot this turn, this attack does 90 more damage.

attacks.name: Sonic Edge

name: Blitzle
flavorText: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use their flashing manes to communicate with one another.

name: Zebstrika

flavorText: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

name: Joltik

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

flavorText: Joltik that live in cities have learned a technique for sucking electricity from the outlets in houses.

name: Galvantula

attacks.name: Discharge

flavorText: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.

name: Stunfisk

flavorText: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

name: Woobat
flavorText: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.

name: Swoobat

attacks.name: Happy Return

flavorText: It emits sound waves of various frequencies from its nose, including some powerful enough to destroy rocks.

name: Sigilyph

flavorText: They never vary the route they fly, because their memories of guarding an ancient city remain steadfast.

name: Yamask

attacks.name: Focused Wish
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

flavorText: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.

name: Cofagrigus

attacks.name: Perplex

flavorText: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.

name: Gothita
flavorText: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.

name: Gothorita

attacks.name: Fortunate Eye
attacks.text: Look at the top 5 cards of your opponent's deck and put them back in any order.

flavorText: They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading people astray are told in every corner.

attacks.name: Synchro Shot
attacks.text: If you have the same number of cards in your hand as your opponent, this attack does 90 more damage.

flavorText: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.

name: Frillish

attacks.name: Oceanic Gloom

flavorText: With its thin, veil-like arms wrapped around the body of its opponent, it sinks to the ocean floor.

flavorText: When it overflows with power, the orange crystal on its body glows. It looks for underground water in caves.
